prompt_cn:
【动作集】用于 AI 漫剧资产库
所属角色：CHR_001
表项（18 项，基线）：站立 / 行走 / 奔跑 / 坐 / 跪 / 躺 / 转身 / 回头 / 抬手 / 拔武器 / 持物 / 拥抱 / 对峙 / 防御 / 攻击 / 跌倒 / 扶墙 / 回眸
版式：pose sheet, multiple poses of the same character side by side, full body
一致性锚点（**绝不允许变**）：FACE / HAIR / AGE / BODY PROPORTION / CLOTHING STATE
允许改变：姿态 / 重心 / 四肢角度 / 动势
动作必须符合：人体结构 — 关节活动范围正确 ； 重心 — 有真实支撑点与重心线 ； 力学 — 发力链合理 ； 角色身份 — 姿态气质与身份匹配（贵族/武士/平民不通用） ； 服装限制 — 长袍不能做紧身裤动作，重甲不能灵活翻滚 ； 道具使用方式 — 握持方式与 PROP 资产卡记录一致
服装状态：（未指定，需与剧情阶段一致）
道具引用：（无）
背景：纯净背景，同一角色多动作并排
品质：8K 超清、拟真影视级
prompt_en:
Create a professional pose sheet for a cinematic AI-animation character asset library.
SUBJECT: CHR_001
ITEMS: standing, weight distributed, shoulder line level · walking, stride length, arms swinging in opposition · running, forward lean angle, airborne moment · sitting, spinal curve, legs crossed · kneeling, knee-on-ground angle · lying down, body axis, head turned · turning, waist-led rotation, hair inertia · looking back, neck-shoulder separation, gaze target · raising a hand, scapula follow-through, knuckle shape · drawing a weapon, grip method, wrist angle · holding an object, grip matched to the prop ID · embracing, both centres of gravity, arm enclosure · standoff, distance, eyelines, balance or asymmetry · defending, guarding the centre of gravity, block point · attacking, force chain foot to waist to shoulder to hand · falling, moment of imbalance, support point · leaning on a wall, hand contact point, body tilt · glancing back, extreme head-shoulder twist, gaze
CONSISTENCY CONSTRAINTS (must NOT change): FACE, HAIR, AGE, BODY PROPORTION, CLOTHING STATE
MUTABLE (only these may change): pose, centre of gravity, limb angles, motion
PHYSICS CHECKS (must all hold): human anatomy — correct joint range of motion | centre of gravity — real support point and gravity line | mechanics — plausible force chain | character identity — posture and bearing match the character's station | costume limits — no tight-trouser poses in long robes, no agile rolls in heavy armour | prop usage — grip must match the PROP asset card
LAYOUT: pose sheet, multiple poses of the same character side by side, full body, pose sheet, multiple poses of the same character side by side, full body, standing, weight distributed, shoulder line level, walking, stride length, arms swinging in opposition, running, forward lean angle, airborne moment, sitting, spinal curve, legs crossed, kneeling, knee-on-ground angle, lying down, body axis, head turned, turning, waist-led rotation, hair inertia, looking back, neck-shoulder separation, gaze target, raising a hand, scapula follow-through, knuckle shape, drawing a weapon, grip method, wrist angle, holding an object, grip matched to the prop ID, embracing, both centres of gravity, arm enclosure, standoff, distance, eyelines, balance or asymmetry, defending, guarding the centre of gravity, block point, attacking, force chain foot to waist to shoulder to hand, falling, moment of imbalance, support point, leaning on a wall, hand contact point, body tilt, glancing back, extreme head-shoulder twist, gaze, consistent character
CONSISTENCY: the same character in every pose — face, age, hairstyle, body proportion and clothing state identical. Every pose must obey anatomy, a real centre of gravity and plausible force chains; no broken limbs, no reversed joints, no floating.
BACKGROUND: pure white background or seamless white studio background, no environmental scene, no scenery, no props.
LIGHTING: soft even studio lighting, subtle ambient illumination, soft contact shadow, no harsh shadows, cinematic lighting quality — so that fabric, skin, metal and leather read clearly.
CINEMATIC QUALITY (concrete, not just the word 'cinematic'): controlled key light, soft fill, subtle rim light, physically plausible falloff, controlled contrast, cinematic depth, foreground / midground / background separation, restrained color palette, material separation
STYLE: ultra-detailed photorealistic hyper-detailed character design, professional game character design sheet. Quality targets: photorealistic / lifelike priority; ultra-high detail; 8K-level visual detail; cinematic lighting quality.
